messages:
samira: quick heads-up  i'm opening a small PR to unify the 429 examples in the error reference. current page has separate JS/py snippets with inconsistent Retry-After handling and a dead SDK anchor. i'll replace with one canonical JS snippet, a tiny Go example (ops requested), and a short note about seconds vs http-date parsing. will push in ~10m.
owen: good plan. include the exact hosted SDK call in the JS snippet and show the recommended retry config: maxRetries, baseMs, capMs, jitter. folks copy those verbatim.
jules: +1 for the Go example. show header-first behavior and a capped exponential fallback. also add a single-line ops guidance under "fallbacks": prefer model variant when fidelity matters, quantized fallback if latency/cost is primary.
link-bot: linkcheck: broken link detected in error-reference/429.md -> "/docs/sdk/retries-old" returns 404 (reported 3h ago)
samira: fixed the link target to `/docs/sdk/retries-guide#quick-policies` in the draft and added a CI linkcheck tweak to catch anchor moves. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1620
owen: can you include a tiny helper for parsing Retry-After (handles numeric seconds and RFC1123 dates)? it saves a lot of Qs.
samira: adding this helper in JS and Go: ```js
function parseRetryAfter(h){if(!h) return null;const s=Number(h);if(!Number.isNaN(s)) return s*1000;const t=Date.parse(h);return Number.isNaN(t)?null:Math.max(0,t-Date.now());}
```
ryan: add a one-line cross-ref in runtime/faq explaining that runtime trims input to fit model limits before choosing fallbacks. that explains why some fallbacks see shortened prompts.
samira: done — added runtime link + changelog entry and requested @jules for review. once CI is green i'll merge and post a 2-line note to #support and #runtime to cut down duplicate tickets.
